cycle_dates_check.name: cycle_dates_check
cycle_dates_check.value: ("cycle"."start_date" is null and "cycle"."end_date" is null) or ("cycle"."start_date" is not null and "cycle"."end_date" is not null and "cycle"."start_date" <= "cycle"."end_date")

module_dates_check.name: module_dates_check
module_dates_check.value: "module"."start_date" is null or "module"."target_date" is null or "module"."start_date" <= "module"."target_date"

notification_workspace_missing_idx.name: notification_workspace_missing_idx
notification_workspace_missing_idx.where: "notification"."workspace_id" is null and "notification"."resource_type" is not null

page_logo_check.name: page_logo_check
page_logo_check.value: ("page"."logo_kind" is null and "page"."logo_value" is null) or ("page"."logo_kind" in ('emoji', 'icon') and "page"."logo_value" is not null)

page_template_logo_check.name: page_template_logo_check
page_template_logo_check.value: ("page_template"."logo_kind" is null and "page_template"."logo_value" is null) or ("page_template"."logo_kind" in ('emoji', 'icon') and "page_template"."logo_value" is not null)

workspace_ai_setting_caps_check.name: workspace_ai_setting_caps_check
workspace_ai_setting_caps_check.value: ("workspace_ai_setting"."monthly_cap_micros" is null or "workspace_ai_setting"."monthly_cap_micros" >= 0) and ("workspace_ai_setting"."user_daily_cap_tokens" is null or "workspace_ai_setting"."user_daily_cap_tokens" >= 0)
